title: NotificationEventRequest
description: Request body of POST /api/internal/notifications/events. One event plus its audience. Source of truth: ui/src/lib/notifications/request.ts and envelope.ts. Unknown fields are dropped by the server, not stored and not rejected, so additionalProperties is true. Strings are trimmed before length checks. The `type` enum is the BUILT-IN set of 12 types only; a registry for app-declared types is being added separately and is not part of this contract.

id.description: Producer-chosen event id. Required, non-blank after trimming. It is used in the JetStream de-duplication id, but NOT in the inbox event key (see attempt_id).

type.description: BUILT-IN event types only (ui/src/lib/notifications/taxonomy.ts). A registry for app-declared types is being added separately; its rules are not defined here.

version.description: Envelope schema version. Only 1 is accepted. Any other value is rejected with 400.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. The server accepts anything Date.parse can read and stores it normalized to UTC. Send RFC 3339.

resource.description: The thing the event is about. Part of the idempotency key.

attempt_id.description: Idempotency discriminator. Event key = type + resource.type + resource.id + attempt_id + recipient. Redelivery of the same attempt_id is ignored. A retry that should create a new notification must use a new attempt_id.

correlation_id.description: Optional. A blank, non-string, or over-long value is silently omitted by the server rather than rejected.

href.description: Optional same-app relative path. Must start with a single slash. Must not start with //. External URLs are rejected.

recipients.description: Explicit recipients, at most 50. Each needs a non-blank subject or email. Resolved against the users collection; identifiers come from that record, not the request. If both are given they must name the same user, else the recipient is rejected.

include_org_admins.description: When true, also notify direct organization admins (OpenFGA user: tuples). Admins who hold the role only through a team are not expanded.

recipient_subject.description: Legacy single-recipient form. Treated as one extra entry in recipients.

recipient_email.description: Legacy single-recipient form. Treated as one extra entry in recipients.
